summary: Nocera, Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose an Equity Purchase Facility Agreement (EPFA) with an institutional investor. The company has the right, but not obligation, to sell up to $100 million of newly issued common stock over 24 months via advance notices at agreed pricing. No mandatory minimum advances, but the investor's ownership is capped at 4.99% (may be raised to 9.99%). Nasdaq rules limit issuance to 19.99% of outstanding without stockholder approval. The investor gets a right of first refusal on subsequent placements, and the company cannot enter variable-rate transactions during the restricted period. Curvature Securities LLC acted as placement agent. This is an equity line facility, not a traditional capital return event.
